# David Gerbino — dmgerbino.com

> Personal hub for David Gerbino: fintech data builder and writer. Essays and
> notes on fintech, banking data, regulatory analytics, and building with AI,
> plus an index of live projects.

David Gerbino builds fintech data tools solo, shipping on nights and weekends.
He writes about banking data (FFIEC call reports, Summary of Deposits, NDFI
exposure), fintech infrastructure, and AI-augmented workflows.

## Writing

- [Writing index](https://www.dmgerbino.com/writing): essays on fintech, banking data, and AI
- [Notes](https://www.dmgerbino.com/notes): shorter observations and links

## Projects

- [NDFI Tracker](https://ndfi-tracker.com): U.S. bank lending exposure tracker monitoring non-depository financial institution (NDFI) risk across 4,500+ banks using FFIEC call report data
- [Fintech Newsletters](https://fintechnewsletters.com): curated directory of fintech newsletters
